name: Novotel Living Bangkok Sukhumvit Legacy
short_description: An extended-stay Novotel Living with spacious studios in Sukhumvit, holding a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (1,265 reviews), with a pool and fitness centre.
ai_summary: Novotel Living Bangkok Sukhumvit Legacy offers spacious studios positioned for both short and extended stays in Bangkok's Sukhumvit area. The property holds a strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 1,265 reviews. Facilities include a pool, fitness centre, and convenient BTS Skytrain access, aimed at travellers who want to live, work, and stay longer-term in the neighbourhood. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 12-14 Sukhumvit 29 Alley, Klong Toey Nua, Watthana, 10110 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from a large base of 1,265 reviews
Spacious studio format suited to extended stays, with pool and fitness centre
Convenient BTS Skytrain access in the vibrant Sukhumvit 29 area
cons: Extended-stay/residence format may feel less service-intensive than a traditional full-service hotel for short leisure stays
